findings.text: non-blocking: panel["visual_inspection"] is the very dict object the patched _label_defects returned into captured["counts"], so the assertion compares a value with itself and holds whatever the renderer does.

non-blocking: the title assertion is fed the circuit_context by the test itself and nothing asserts benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py:764-769 still populates family and circuit, so deleting those two keys would leave the test green while every rendered title fell back to "boundary-circuit current".

non-blocking: _hollow_markers post-processes the artists nova/media/poloidal.py:540 draw_nulls just appended, in a module that already parameterises null colour and marker through InkStyle.variant at benchmarks/coil_edit_latency.py:2098, so the fill decision is now made away from its owner.

non-blocking: the redraw replaced the published receipt with the panel subcommand's six-key output and dropped state_archive, state_archive_md5, solve, render, set, figure, figure_vector, assembly_drawn and near_x_geometry, so the receipt no longer records the archive digest or the source revision the figure was drawn from.

non-blocking: test_committed_converged_panel_uses_its_terminal_currents was the only executed guard on the published receipt's display_map and it was deselected from both arms; the compared display_map is in fact unchanged between base and head, so the exclusion is defensible but leaves the claim unverified by any run.

non-blocking: measurement_command carries an unsubstituted "<run>" placeholder and the counts were measured from a fresh render into the run directory rather than from the published titan-converged-vs-nonconverged.png beside the receipt, which the removed inspected_render key no longer identifies.
